note:
`engine = "julia"` fits every factor with treatment contrasts
(`contr.treatment()`: dummy columns against the first level), but R would code
the `mu` formula's design differently:
• g: an ordered factor (R codes it with contr.poly)
✖ The two engines would then return different coefficients under identical
  names.
ℹ Refit with plain treatment-coded factors (`factor(x, levels = ...)` with
  `ordered = FALSE`, no `contrasts` attribute, default `options("contrasts")`),
  or use `engine = "tmb"`.
